scope: Five unresized, unedited texture-source paintings only.

runs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
Asset: one orthographic albedo texture-source painting for the Hesper shield burst cell. Produce exactly one 1024 x 1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent background.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 (guide_front.png) is the EDIT TARGET and the absolute authority for ALL geometry, silhouette, every part boundary, occlusion, scale, framing and pixel placement. Image 2 (design_reference.png) is MATERIAL AND COLOUR REFERENCE ONLY. Paint Image 1; never replace its geometry with Image 2's geometry or camera.
VIEW: FRONT. Preserve the guide's overlapping cylinders, horizontal bands and all four visible vertical gold rails exactly, including their asymmetric spacing. The top square crosspiece is viewed edge-on, with the small gold plug rising above it. Keep the source guide's exact overlap pattern.
LOCK THE GUIDE: Preserve its entire alpha silhouette exactly pixel for pixel. Keep the exact outline, every bevel, every edge, existing proportions and spacing, object size and position. Preserve each part's boundary and all transparent pixels. Nothing outside that silhouette, nothing cropped. No zoom, recentering, warping, added parts or altered construction. Guide shadows and guide material tints are not albedo and must be replaced.
SURFACE PAINT: Transfer the approved reference's warm white/ivory ceramic with fine subtle wear and hairline surface marks; restrained brushed antique yellow gold with fine grain; charcoal black-violet resin only in fine decorative insets/seams as appropriate to the reference; luminous cyan/blue-white energy behind glass in the guide's pale blue panels. Paint the blue panels with fine blue-white plasma filaments as in the reference, bright light colour contained entirely inside their original guide boundaries. Gold rails and bands must remain gold, ceramic endcaps/crosspiece must remain ceramic. Use fine engraved nonalphabetic lines, seams, panel joins and small geometric details as surface painting, without changing geometry. Unseen faces plausibly continue these same materials. Do not add unrelated orange, leather, cloth or paper.
LIGHTING: This is FLAT BASE COLOUR / ALBEDO for projection onto a 3D model. Even, flat, shadowless illumination from the viewer. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion or darkening between parts, no directional shading gradients, no strong specular highlights, reflected scenery, reflection streaks, rim light or baked bloom. Metal is its base gold colour with only a very faint sheen; ceramic is evenly white/ivory; glowing panels are their bright cyan-blue-white light colour. Remove the gray cast shadows visible in the guide. Fine dark seams are material markings, not wide shading.
OUTPUT: Only the painted guide on true transparent alpha, no floor, background, border, labels, letters, text, numerals or watermark. Preserve the guide's exact silhouette and part placement above all.
runs.reason: Corrective regeneration required: silhouette/placement drift and remaining shading/highlights.
